question_en:
The marine survey team needs to select representative frames suitable for scale calibration from historical seafloor videos. The full scope includes all files in the Wikimedia Commons category "Dogger Bank" whose filenames belong to the "Dogger Bank SCI (CEND 07-08)" series and whose station numbers range from STN014 to STN054 (inclusive). Please answer:

After examining the main image of each file one by one, how many distinct, clearly visible red reference laser dots are present in each image? Provide a complete itemized table containing "Filename, Station Number, Count of Red Laser Dots". Which files have four red reference laser dots clearly visible at the same time in their main images, making them "suitable for calibration"? Which files belong to the "suitable for calibration" group and which to the "not suitable for calibration" group, and what are the respective counts?

Frames with fewer than four red reference laser dots are classified as "not suitable for calibration". Each member of the full set must appear exactly once.

The answer must include a complete itemized table with "Filename—Station Number—Count of Red Laser Dots—Grouping", followed by a Q&A section listing the files and counts for each of the two groups separately.

# Detailed Simulated Retrieval Trajectory · 1-2-E03

## Step 01 · parse_task / Define set, image unit, and delivery fields

Action: Read the question, separate "full scope," "visual conditions," "itemized table," and "summary"; first establish the complete list of all members, then perform filtering.

Evidence observation (archived evidence summary): All files in the Commons Dogger Bank category whose filenames belong to the Dogger Bank SCI (CEND 07-08) series and whose station numbers range from STN014 to STN054 (inclusive); judge only the default main image of each file.

Unified judgment rule: Count distinct, clearly visible red reference laser dots in the same default main image; calibration is allowed only if four dots are clearly visible simultaneously. Fewer than 4 dots means not suitable for calibration; white boxes, shadows, red scattered light paths, or dots inferred from a four-corner layout do not count as clear reference dots.

Result of this step: Determine the current predicate; each formal member must appear in exactly one row; do not retrieve or report only positive examples.

## Step 02 · search / Locate the collection entry for the specified institution

Action: Example query: "Wikimedia Commons Dogger Bank SCI CEND 07-08 STN014 STN054". Verify the publishing institution, title, and version from search candidates, and open the specified collection or publication entry.

Evidence observation (archived evidence summary): Traceable sources are 17 frozen Commons API file/pageid/imageinfo default previews, station number information, and main image red dot counts. The entry provides all candidates and image associations, not a partial sample constructed from the final hit list.

Evidence links:
- Collection/version entry: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Dogger_Bank

Result of this step: Lock the following real source URLs, then expand members within them.
